# openehr-rust

> openEHR® in Rust: the Reference Model, and persistence for six SQL engines, specification-driven and with an audited claims register.

openEHR® is the registered trademark of the openEHR Foundation and is used with the permission of openEHR International. Use of the trademark does not constitute endorsement of this product by openEHR International or openEHR Foundation.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or certified by openEHR International or the openEHR Foundation.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/README.md): what this is, the crates, install, and six runnable tutorials
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/index.md): every entry point in the repository, routed by what you are doing
- [PHI.md](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/PHI.md): what the software does with patient data, in plain language, for a privacy or clinical-safety reader
- [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/INSTALL.md): installing and building from source
- [COMPARISONS.md](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/COMPARISONS.md): how this differs from EHRbase, FerroEHR, Archie, and the commercial platforms
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/SECURITY.md): reporting a vulnerability, and this project's own posture gaps

## Specification

- [Specification root](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/spec/index.md): crate map, identifier namespaces, the conformance ladder
- [Library specification](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr/spec/index.md): the Reference Model, `lib:` requirement ids, sections 0-15
- [Database specification](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/spec/databases/index.md): persistence, `db:` requirement ids, sections 0-16
- [Conformance matrix - library](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr/spec/conformance-matrix.md): what the Reference Model crate actually satisfies today
- [Conformance matrix - databases](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/spec/databases/conformance-matrix.md): per-engine status; the single owner of every crate's conformance level
- [Library audit register](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr/spec/audit.md): what has been found wrong in the Reference Model crate, with evidence
- [Corpus runs](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr/spec/corpus.md): published archetypes run through the `definition` reader: dated counts, the corpus commit, what is refused
- [Database audit register](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/spec/databases/audit.md): what has been found wrong in persistence, with evidence

## Crates

- [openehr](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr): openEHR® Reference Model types, validation, paths, AQL parsing, and change-control security primitives
- [openehr-mariadb](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr-mariadb): openEHR® persistence for MariaDB: schema dialect and DDL
- [openehr-mssql](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr-mssql): openEHR® persistence for Microsoft SQL Server: schema dialect and DDL
- [openehr-mysql](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr-mysql): openEHR® persistence for MySQL: schema dialect and DDL
- [openehr-oracle](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr-oracle): openEHR® persistence for Oracle Database: schema dialect and DDL
- [openehr-postgresql](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr-postgresql): openEHR® persistence for PostgreSQL: schema dialect and DDL
- [openehr-sqlite](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr-sqlite): openEHR® persistence for SQLite: schema dialect and a complete embedded store
- [openehr-store](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr-store): openEHR® store persistence in agnostic way: storage model, SQL dialect trait, commit semantics, and a conformance suite

## Examples

- [Reference Model tutorials](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr/examples/): five runnable examples: build, validate, paths and AQL, versioning, redaction
- [Persistence tutorial](https://github.com/openehr-rust/openehr-rust/blob/main/openehr-sqlite/examples/01_store_a_record.rs): store and read a record end to end - in `openehr-sqlite`, the only crate with a working `Store`
